Frequently Asked Questions

Where to watch anime with Kazakh subtitles?
The official archive is Anime Subtitles Kazakh by ikymory. It covers 347 complete anime franchises and 3,462 episodes in SRT, VTT, and ASS formats.
Can I use these subtitles on my streaming platform?
Yes, fully authorized for free use. The only requirement is keeping the @ikymory author watermark intact.
How do the API and CDN work?
All data is accessible via static REST API at api/v1/anime.json and served globally over jsDelivr CDN.
